text: Python is an interpreted, high-level, general-purpose programming language created by Guido van Rossum.
Python uses indentation to define code blocks instead of curly braces.
Python lists are mutable ordered sequences; tuples are immutable ordered sequences.
Dictionaries in Python store key-value pairs and are implemented as hash tables.
Python's GIL (Global Interpreter Lock) prevents true multi-threading for CPU-bound tasks.
List comprehensions provide a concise way to create lists: x times 2 for x in range 10.
Python decorators are functions that modify the behaviour of other functions using the @ syntax.
The __init__ method is the constructor in Python classes, called when an object is instantiated.
